Key held, or as soon as you talk

Voice is proximity-based: you are heard up to the chosen range, fading with distance, like in real life. The microphone and speakers are Windows' default devices.\n\nTalk: \"Press V\" (key held, set in the Keys tab) or \"Automatic\" (the mic opens as soon as you talk, above the threshold; F6 mutes it). Voice volume only changes what you hear; your microphone, what the others hear from you.

Settings > Sound & voice, \"Talk\": Press V (you talk while holding the key, as before) or Automatic (the mic opens as soon as you talk; adjustable threshold, F6 mutes it). Also in the lobby, Options > Mine.
When hosting, pick \"New game\": the difficulty shows right below. Vanilla: the game as is; Easy, Medium, Hard: starting money and fuel; Random. For everyone, MWC and MSC. Default: Settings > Co-op.
